episodes.title: Sorry for Your Loss
episodes.summary: When her father dies, and her school bully returns to town, a quiet wallflower is triggered to a violent breaking point.

episodes.title: This Sort of Thing Needs Some Feminine Energy
episodes.summary: When Rhiannon's victim is discovered, she goes on a mission to find out who he was – and whether he deserved it.

episodes.title: Black Spots in the Garage
episodes.summary: High on power and righteousness, Rhiannon goes after her next target: the ultimate bully, Julia Blenkingsopp.

episodes.title: Everybody Loves Julia
episodes.summary: Rhiannon sets out to prove she's not the loser she once was, until a revelation changes everything.

episodes.title: Someone’s Been a Naughty Girl
episodes.summary: With suspicion swirling around Rhiannon, she has to partner with an unlikely ally – but will things go to plan?

episodes.title: Life 2.0
episodes.summary: Rhiannon might just get away with it – but what does she stand to lose in the process?
